name: Plateau
summary: This EA identifies plateau or consolidation phases in price movement and enters trades when a breakout from the plateau occurs. It combines plateau detection logic with trend-following entry to capture momentum shifts after periods of sideways price action. The system manages positions with stop loss and take profit levels derived from the plateau range.
summary_zh: 该EA识别价格走势中的平台期或盘整阶段，并在平台突破时入场交易。它结合平台检测逻辑与趋势跟踪入场，捕捉横盘整理后的动量突破。系统通过平台区间推导的止损和止盈水平来管理仓位。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心概念是检测价格进入平台期（盘整区域），即价格在一定范围内窄幅波动形成平台，然后等待突破方向确认后入场。入场条件为价格从平台区域向上或向下突破时开仓，做多对应向上突破，做空对应向下突破。出场条件包括基于平台高度计算的止盈和止损，以及可选的移动止损来锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面，EA根据平台区间的波动幅度来动态调整止损距离，但总体风险控制依赖于用户合理设置参数。策略还包含了一定的过滤机制，避免在虚假突破时入场。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept is detecting when price enters a plateau phase—a consolidation zone where price oscillates within a narrow range—and then entering on a breakout from that plateau. Entry conditions trigger when price breaks above the plateau upper boundary for long positions or below the lower boundary for short positions, confirming a directional momentum shift. Exit conditions include a stop loss placed on the opposite side of the plateau boundary and a take profit calculated as a multiple of the plateau height, plus an optional trailing stop to lock in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or a balance-proportional method to keep per-trade risk consistent and manageable. Money management dynamically adjusts stop loss distance based on the measured plateau range height, though overall risk control depends heavily on user-configured parameters being set prudently. The strategy incorporates some filtering logic to reduce the likelihood of entering on false breakouts from the consolidation zone.

parameters.name: PlateauPeriod
parameters.description: 平台检测周期，用于判断盘整区间的K线数量
parameters.description_en: Plateau detection period; bars for consolidation range

parameters.name: BreakoutDistance
parameters.description: 突破确认距离（点数），价格超过平台边界该距离后确认突破
parameters.description_en: Breakout confirmation distance; price must exceed boundary by this

parameters.name: StopLossMultiplier
parameters.description: 止损乘数，止损距离=平台高度×该乘数
parameters.description_en: Stop loss multiplier; SL = plateau height × multiplier

parameters.name: TakeProfitMultiplier
parameters.description: 止盈乘数，止盈距离=平台高度×该乘数
parameters.description_en: Take profit multiplier; TP = plateau height × multiplier

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description: 是否启用移动止损功能

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 移动止损跟踪步长（点数）

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number; 0 monitors all orders

pros: 平台检测逻辑合理，在盘整后捕捉突破具有较高的胜率潜力
止损和止盈基于平台高度动态计算，适应不同波动率环境
设有最大持仓限制，避免过度开仓导致风险失控
包含移动止损功能，能有效保护已获利润
策略概念清晰，参数可调性强，便于优化和适应不同品种
pros_en: Plateau detection logic is sound—capturing breakouts after consolidation has high win-rate potential
Dynamic SL/TP calculation based on plateau height adapts well to varying volatility environments
Maximum position limit prevents overexposure and uncontrolled risk accumulation
Trailing stop feature effectively protects unrealized profits as trades move favorably
Clear strategy concept with highly tunable parameters facilitates optimization across different instruments
cons: 平台检测对参数敏感，不同品种和周期需要重新优化
缺乏虚假突破的深度过滤机制，可能在窄幅震荡中被反复止损
没有考虑交易成本（点差和佣金）对盈利的影响，在低波动平台中问题尤为突出
固定手数模式下未与账户风险动态关联，可能导致过度或不足的风险暴露
缺少多时间框架确认，单周期突破可能只是噪音而非趋势启动
cons_en: Plateau detection is parameter-sensitive and requires re-optimization for different instruments and timeframes
Lacks deep false-breakout filtering, which may cause repeated stop-outs in choppy narrow-range markets
Trading costs (spread and commission) impact on profitability are not accounted for, especially problematic in low-volatility plateaus
Fixed lot mode is not dynamically linked to account risk, potentially leading to over- or under-exposure
Missing multi-timeframe confirmation means single-period breakouts could be noise rather than trend initiation
improvements: 增加多时间框架确认机制，例如在H4平台突破时要求H1趋势方向一致
加入点差过滤和最小平台高度阈值，避免在交易成本过高或盘整不充分时入场
实现基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位计算，替代固定手数模式
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe confirmation, e.g., require H1 trend direction alignment when H4 plateau breakout signals
Incorporate spread filtering and minimum plateau height threshold to avoid entries when costs are too high or consolidation is insufficient
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage to replace the fixed lot approach

risk_points: 缺乏虚假突破深度过滤，可能在震荡行情中连续止损造成资金回撤
固定手数模式未与账户风险动态挂钩，小账户可能单笔风险过大
未考虑点差和佣金成本，低波动品种中盈利可能被交易成本吞噬
risk_points_en: Lack of deep false-breakout filtering may cause consecutive stop-outs and drawdown in choppy markets
Fixed lot sizing is not dynamically tied to account risk, potentially over-risking small accounts
Spread and commission costs are not factored in, which may erode profits on low-volatility instruments
